title: Orientation to Graphic Design & Core Design Principles
notes: Virtual session. Introduction to fundamental design principles: contrast, hierarchy, balance, proximity, and space.

title: Typography Hierarchy, Font Pairing & Typefaces Lab
notes: Physical lab session. Practice font selection, kerning, leading, tracking, and establishing typographic hierarchy.

title: Grid Systems, Alignment & Visual Balance Lab
notes: Physical lab session. Apply column grids, baseline grids, and symmetrical/asymmetrical balance rules.

title: Layout Composition & Editorial Design Execution
notes: Physical lab session. Construct a multi-page poster and flyer layout incorporating typography and grids.

title: Week 1 Design Review & Timed Quiz 1
notes: Virtual session. Peer review of layout submissions and execution of Timed Weekly Quiz 1.

title: Color Psychology, Harmonies & Brand Palettes Briefing
notes: Virtual session. Explore color wheels, complementary/analogous harmonies, RGB/CMYK spaces, and color psychology.

title: Vector Artwork Creation & Pen Tool Mastery Lab
notes: Physical lab session. Master vector Bezier curves, anchor points, and boolean shape operations.

title: Logo Design Principles & Iconography Studio
notes: Physical lab session. Design minimalist brand mark logos, wordmarks, and custom icon sets.

title: Vector Brand Asset Creation & Assignment 1 Submission
notes: Physical lab session. Finalize vector logo packages in primary, secondary, and monochrome variants. Submit Assignment 1.

title: Week 2 Logo Review & Timed Quiz 2
notes: Virtual session. Critique vector logo submissions and execute Timed Weekly Quiz 2.

title: Raster vs Vector Graphics & Image Editing Overview
notes: Virtual session. Image resolution (DPI/PPI), raster file formats (PNG, JPG, WEBP), and editing workflows.

title: Non-Destructive Masking, Retouching & Color Correction
notes: Physical lab session. Apply layer masks, adjustment layers, healing brushes, and color grading techniques.

title: Social Media Banner Design & Ad Campaigns Studio
notes: Physical lab session. Create multi-platform promotional graphic banners for digital marketing campaigns.

title: Execution of Practical Skills Assessment 1 (Asset Creation)
notes: Physical lab exam. 60-Minute practical test creating custom vector logos and social media campaign graphics.

title: Week 3 Design Critique & Timed Quiz 3
notes: Virtual session. Review assessment design outputs and execute Timed Weekly Quiz 3.

title: Brand Style Guides, Collateral Systems & Pitching Briefing
notes: Virtual session. Overview of comprehensive visual identity systems, brand guidelines, and client collateral.

title: Constructing Complete Brand Style Guides Lab
notes: Physical lab session. Compile typography guidelines, color usage rules, logo clear-space rules, and brand assets.

title: Preparing Brand Mockups & Presentation Decks
notes: Physical lab session. Apply realistic product mockups (stationery, signage, digital displays). Submit Assignment 2.

title: Execution of Practical Skills Assessment 2 (Brand Identity)
notes: Physical lab exam. 60-Minute practical test building a complete Brand Identity Kit and Presentation Deck.

title: GD-101 Final Review, Portfolio Showcase & Timed Quiz 4
notes: Virtual session. Final portfolio review, grade updates, and execution of Timed Weekly Quiz 4.
